name: Clarification resumed → awaiting_approval→executing (+ clear markers)
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4b-2 PR-2 — the interactive-RESUME transition, half 2 (the run-entity transition). Fires on the RUN entity (agent.chain.execution.<runID>) when rule 10 has stamped agent.run.clarification_resumed there AND the run is parked in `awaiting_approval`. Advances the run back to `executing` via lifecycle_transition and clears BOTH clarification markers, so the run resumes honestly and a future clarification can pause again. The mirror of pause rule 09.

ORDERED on_enter (bounce-proof): (1) lifecycle_transition awaiting_approval→executing; (2) remove_triple agent.run.clarification_pending; (3) remove_triple agent.run.clarification_resumed. The ORDER + rule 09's resume-mutual-exclusion guard (agent.run.clarification_resumed length_eq 0) make a pause↔resume bounce impossible at EVERY intermediate KV revision, WITHOUT needing an atomic-write primitive:
  R0 (pre): phase=awaiting_approval, pending set, resumed set — rule 11 matches.
  R1 (after transition): phase=executing, pending set, resumed set — rule 09 blocked (its clarification_resumed length_eq 0 guard fails; resumed is still set).
  R2 (after remove pending): phase=executing, pending GONE, resumed set — rule 09 blocked (its clarification_pending ne "" fails).
  R3 (after remove resumed): phase=executing, both gone — rule 09 blocked (pending gone).
At no revision can rule 09 re-fire, so the run cannot bounce back to awaiting_approval. clarification_pending is removed BEFORE clarification_resumed precisely so the window between R2 and R3 (resumed-still-set, pending-gone) is also safe.

WHY clear BOTH markers (not just for cleanliness): clarification_resumed MUST be cleared or rule 09 stays permanently blocked (the guard) and a SECOND clarification could never pause. clarification_pending MUST be cleared or rule 09 would re-fire the instant clarification_resumed is gone. Both are required for repeated ask→answer cycles to work.

PHASE GUARD IS A TOP-LEVEL CONDITION (agent.run.phase==awaiting_approval), not an action `when` — same discipline as 02/03/04/09. The awaiting_approval→executing edge is already legal in the upstream transition table (agentrun.go), so no lifecycle change.

DISTINCT FROM 4c: this resumes a 4b-2 CLARIFICATION pause (gated on clarification_resumed). A 4c tool-gate pause sets pending_approval and is resumed by its own (future) rule; this rule does not touch it.

INERT UNTIL semstreams#256: rule 10 (which stamps the trigger) cannot fire until the reply path threads the run anchor + reply discriminator. The behavioral mock journey is DEFERRED to #256's landing — it will drive the real reply path and assert phase awaiting_approval→executing + both markers cleared + NO re-pause (no seeding; there is no triple-write seam in the e2e harness today). Until then, pinned STRUCTURALLY by TestAgentRunPack_ClarificationResumeTransition (exact 3-action order + subject-less removes) + TestAgentRunPack_PauseResumeBounceGuard.

No atomic-write primitive needed; bounce is impossible regardless of re-eval granularity.
